oauthlogin-desc: Allows users to authenticate through an external OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect provider.
oauthlogin-error-generic: OAuth login failed. Please try again or contact an administrator.
oauthlogin-error-state: The OAuth response could not be verified or has expired. Please start again.
oauthlogin-error-denied: You cancelled the login at the identity provider.
oauthlogin-error-provider: The identity provider reported an error.
oauthlogin-error-domain: Your verified email domain is not allowed to sign in here.
oauthlogin-error-token: The authorization code could not be exchanged for a token.
oauthlogin-error-userinfo: Your profile could not be loaded from the identity provider.
oauthlogin-error-noaccount: No local account is linked to your identity and automatic account creation is not available.
oauthlogin-error-blocked: Your account is blocked and cannot log in.
oauthlogin-missing-config: OAuthLogin is not configured. Set OAuth endpoints, client ID, client secret, and redirect URI in LocalSettings.php.
